timeline.summary: Mangalam Worldwide corrected debenture tenure to 36 months with maturity on April 27, 2029
Mangalam Worldwide allotted ₹50 Cr of 10% senior secured NCDs on April 28, 2026, maturing April 28, 2029, secured by a promoter's asset mortgage and another promoter's share pledge.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹264.95 Cr, net profit ₹15.37 Cr.
Mangalam Worldwide Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹0.30 per share (3% face value) for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval.
Mangalam Worldwide's ₹50 Cr 10% secured NCDs (ISIN INE0JYY07026) were listed on the NSE debt segment from April 30, 2026, after the April 28 allotment.
On May 15, 2026, Mangalam Worldwide's board approved a 1:10 stock split, reducing face value from ₹10 to ₹1, subject to shareholder approval.
On May 16, 2026, Mangalam Worldwide said its board approved a 1:10 stock split (₹10 shares into ten Re 1 shares), subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.
Mangalam Worldwide received in-principle approval from BSE on May 22, 2026 for direct listing of equity shares on the BSE Mainboard.
Mangalam Worldwide's 2,97,00,674 equity shares were listed on the BSE Mainboard effective May 27, 2026.
Mangalam Worldwide successfully listed its equity shares on the BSE Mainboard on May 27, 2026, achieving dual-exchange status across NSE and BSE.
Government of India issued ₹5 commemorative stamp honoring Late Shri Tejmal Ji Mangal, founder of Mangalam Worldwide, on June 1, 2026, unveiled by Chairman Vipin Prakash Mangal and fourth-gen heirs.
Mangalam Worldwide announced plans to incorporate a wholly-owned subsidiary in Europe.
